description: The objective of this project course enables students to undertake a substantial computing-related project work over a period of one year. Students work individually on self-proposed projects or projects proposed by staff. They will have good opportunity to apply what they have learnt on practical problems, be it research-oriented or software development-oriented. Students should periodically submit a report make a presentation to the respective supervisors. The project will be letter-graded.
preclusion: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( must not have completed 1 of BT4101/CG4001/CP4101/any Courses beginning with XF at a grade of at least D )
preclusionRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) CG4001:D, CP4101:D, BT4101:D, XF%:D)
prerequisite: if undertaking an Undergraduate Degree then ( the student has achieved at least 112 Units prior to enrolment )
title: Computing Project
